  %/ConstantOfShape_404_output_0 = ConstantOfShape[value = <Tensor>](%/Shape_928_output_0)
  %/Add_344_output_0 = Add(%/ConstantOfShape_404_output_0, %/Sub_1_output_0)
  %/Add_345_output_0 = Add(%/Add_344_output_0, %/action_out_proj/Add_output_0)
  %/Shape_929_output_0 = Shape(%/Add_345_output_0)
  %/Expand_442_output_0 = Expand(%/Sub_1_output_0, %/Shape_929_output_0)
  %/Shape_930_output_0 = Shape(%/Add_345_output_0)
  %/Expand_443_output_0 = Expand(%/action_out_proj/Add_output_0, %/Shape_930_output_0)
  %/Sub_50_output_0 = Sub(%/Expand_442_output_0, %/Expand_443_output_0)
  %/Sub_51_output_0 = Sub(%/Expand_442_output_0, %/Expand_443_output_0)
  %losses = Mul(%/Sub_50_output_0, %/Sub_51_output_0)
  return %losses
}
